blind.description: A circular mound of gold coins styled as a dragon's sleeping hoard or hollowed treasure nest, with an oval indentation in the top center. Half-buried along the outer sloped rim are various fantasy loot items including small wooden/metal treasure chests, golden chalices, ingots, a dagger hilt, rings, and cut red and green gemstones. The model is fully solid with stylized bumpy coin-textured surfaces, sitting flat on the ground with no separate base.
blind.from_above: An oval-rimmed golden nest or caldera with a smooth shallow crater in the center, surrounded by a bumpy orange-yellow ring dotted with tiny chests and jewel accents, resembling a baked tart shell or bird's nest.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the figure (around 1.5 feet tall), and about 4 to 4.5 feet in diameter (slightly less than the figure's height).
